messages:
asha_sales: Quick context for a new enterprise win -> VeraHealth. Signed yesterday (ARR ~$280k). Go-live target: 2024-04-15 (customer requested). They want Private deployment (VPC) in eu-west, SAML SSO, and a burst-capable dedicated pool. Main risks: SSO metadata + test IdP not yet provided, data residency paperwork pending, and capacity/perf checks for their retrieval-heavy workload. Contract and signed SOW here: https://company.sales/vera-contract (internal).

ben_cs: Thanks @asha_sales — I’ll take onboarding lead. Can you drop the primary admin contact + SSO metadata (IdP XML or metadata URL)? Also need expected traffic profile (qps, average seq len, embeddings vs chat).

asha_sales: putting contact in thread: vera-admin@verahealth.com (Claire Morton). SSO owner: marcus.vera@verahealth.com. I will DM the SSO metadata after sync with their IdP team later today. Expected load: 400-600 req/min peak, ~1.2k tokens avg per conversation, mix of chat + retrieval/embedded similarity queries (~30% embeddings).

tariq_support: noted. I’ll own infra validation and the private deploy checklist. I need: account id, org aws account/cidr constraints, list of allowed egress endpoints, and a test user for SSO validation. ETA to spin up a staging VPC and smoke test: 48 hours after we get metadata.

ellie_eng: For capacity planning: 600 rpm with those token lengths pushes us to a dedicated n3 pool estimate. Will run quick perf sim once we have exact sequence distribution. If they're heavy on embeddings, we may recommend separate embedding workers to keep chat latency low. Can someone add a short sample workload (percent of inference vs embeddings)?

asha_sales: sample workload: ~70% chat (low-latency critical), 30% batch embeddings. I'll attach a sample CSV of request traces in the ticket.

ben_cs: Created internal tickets and assigned owners. Details:
```
CS-4123 -> Onboarding runbook + account setup (owner: ben_cs)
INF-2210 -> Private deploy + infra validation (owner: tariq_support)
SEC-789  -> SSO validation & data residency checklist (owner: lina_cs)
PERF-614 -> Perf simulations / model recommendation (owner: ellie_eng)
```
Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4123, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2210

lina_cs: I’ll pick up renewal/contract coverage notes and flag any early churn signals. Recommend we schedule a 2-week onboarding sync with the customer and invite security to sign the data residency form.

ben_cs: Owner summary and next steps:
- Ben_CS: onboarding lead, runbook owner, customer kickoff. (Action: schedule kickoff call by EOD tomorrow).
- Tariq_Support: infra validation + staging deploy (Action: open staging infra and post results in INF-2210).
- Ellie_Eng: capacity estimate & perf sims (Action: run initial sim and share model/quantization recommendation).
- Lina_CS: renewal coverage + security/data residency coordination (Action: start legal/security intake).
- Asha_Sales: provide SSO metadata, sample traces, and CLA contact (Action: send metadata and test user).

ben_cs: Quick checklist links: onboarding runbook -> https://go.redwood/onboarding-runbook; private-deploy checklist -> https://go.redwood/private-vpc-checklist.

deploy-bot: INF-2210 created by tariq_support at 2024-03-23T14:20:00Z

tariq_support: I opened INF-2210 and added initial infra notes. Will ping when staging is up.

ben_cs: Thanks team. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when you have the first action done (SSO metadata posted, staging infra live, perf sim initial results). I’ll post a one-pager before the kickoff.

asha_sales: will post SSO metadata today. :thumbsup:

ellie_eng: starting perf sim now, will update INF-2210 with numbers by EOD.

lina_cs: scheduling legal/security intake this afternoon.

ben_cs: closing loop — will run kickoff invite once SSO metadata is in.

asha_sales: thanks all — looping back if customer requests any changes.
